description: Replication package: Transmission, Siting, and the Welfare Cost of AI-Era Electricity Demand in Korea is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Manseok Jo, David Reiner (Korea Research Institute for Human Settlements; Energy Policy Research Group, University of Cambridge). A seventeen-province transport dispatch model of the Korean power system, anchored to the committed generation fleet and demand path of the 11th Basic Plan for Long-term Electricity Supply and Demand. Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
